name: imessage

blocked.reply-quote: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper; the Messages scripting dictionary has no reply option, so a reply cannot quote a message here.
blocked.tapback: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper; the only SIP-on route is UI automation, which this channel does not use.
blocked.edit: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper; Messages exposes no edit verb to scripts.
blocked.unsend: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper; Messages exposes no unsend verb to scripts.
blocked.mark-read: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper that reaches the Messages internals; a read-only database cannot mark a message read.
blocked.group-admin: Needs System Integrity Protection off plus a private-API helper; creating a group, adding or removing members, renaming and leaving are not scriptable with SIP on.
blocked.block: No way on macOS: no command or script verb blocks a number; blocking is a Settings or Phone screen action only.

requires: Full Disk Access and Automation for the terminal running it
